title: Extraction and Ghost
author: Ada Underhill
blurb: Lena Ashgrove, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
